solutions.title: Brute force pairs
solutions.strategy: Test every ordered pair by concatenating and checking whether the result is a palindrome.

timeComplexity.explanation: There are n(n-1) pairs and each check scans up to 2L characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the temporary concatenation/check state is extra beyond output.

solutions.title: Reversed word map
solutions.strategy: Index every word, then split each word and match reversed complements when the opposite side is already a palindrome.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each word has L split points and palindrome/reverse work can scan O(L).

spaceComplexity.explanation: The lookup map stores all words.
